messages:
Marco: pushed a Grafana dashboard for KV prefetch visibility to the eng-runtime folder. Panels: per-model hit%, per-route heatmap, per-customer tokens_saved, prefetch latency, warmup success rate. link: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-prefetch
Alyssa: nice — where does the tokens_saved metric come from? is it exact or an estimate?
Marco: it's an estimate. formula shown in the dashboard: tokens_saved = sum(hit_count * avg_prefix_length_by_route). uses sampled p95/p99 lengths to avoid heavy instrumentation.
Sara: FYI i spotted a big drop in hit% for titan-13B on /chat/auto around 2024-11-03 03:00 UTC. route hit% fell ~40% vs baseline.
Marco: hmm. any recent changes to keying or prompt-normalization around that time?
Sara: we rolled a small normalization tweak (trim + collapse whitespace + lower) and a hashing variant that prefixed model id to the hash last week.
Marco: that model-id prefix change would definitely invalidate prior keys for customers that rely on cross-model sharing. could explain a sudden drop.
Sara: example raw -> hash: `User: What's the weather?` used to hash to `h_9f3...`; new pipeline emits `h_mdl_titan-13B_9f3...`. lots of older keys now miss.
Tomas: for alerts i suggest: fire when tokens_saved_24h drops >30% vs baseline AND route_hit_rate < 20% for >1h. otherwise too many false positives from noise.
Alyssa: can we add a per-customer deploy_tag slice on the dashboard? we've got customers that pin model variants and it helps narrow down regressions.
Marco: good call. i'll add a filter variable for deploy_tag and model_alias. also adding a table that maps normalized_hash -> sample_id (redacted) so we can inspect keying without exposing PII.
eng-bot: dashboard deployed by Marco at 1851234568. panels: 14. refresh: 1m. alerts: none enabled.
Sara: i'll take the backfill task: re-hash historical hits to map old->new keys for 7 days and see how much of the drop is attributable to keying vs behavior.
Alyssa: i'll open a small PR to add the alert thresholds + cookbook blurb for oncall on how to triage cache hit alerts.
Marco: thanks — action items: (1) sara backfill + report (2) alyssa alert PR (3) tomas propose alert thresholds in docs (4) i will add deploy_tag filter + mapping table. leaving notes in dashboard description. :thumbsup:
Sara: will post initial backfill numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Alyssa: i'll add the per-customer panel and a tokens_saved tooltip with the exact formula.
Marco: great. if anyone finds other routes with similar drops, ping me @marco and include sample ids. keeping this thread for follow-ups.
